title: ChaosSwap
description: Randomly swap positions with mobs every 40–60 seconds. Fully customizable with optional effects and instant mode. in the config file
body:
**ChaosSwap**

ChaosSwap is a Fabric mod that randomly swaps your position with a nearby mob every 40–60 seconds, creating unpredictable and chaotic gameplay. You can be mining one moment and suddenly find yourself in a completely different situation.

 Features
- Random player and mob position swapping
- Configurable interval (default 40–60 seconds)
- 100 block swap radius
- Optional effects such as warning message, blindness, and sounds
- Smart Teleporting
  
  The mod includes logic to improve teleport safety and consistency:
  
- If the player is on the surface, swaps will prioritize surface mobs
- If the player is underground, swaps will prioritize cave mobs
- Repeated cave swaps will eventually send the player back to the surface
- Configuration
  
  The mod is fully customizable through the config folder.
  
 You can edit the file:

 config/chaos_swap.json

 From there, you can enable or disable features like:
-
- Warning message
- Blindness effect
- Sounds
- Swap timing and radius
  
 Disabling all effects will result in instant teleportation.
